title: roadcrashVIC
text: roadcrashVIC designed members public want understand road safety Victoria, across state local area. helps answer one question: road crashes Victoria changed since 2012, crashes happen, frequent, road users vulnerable? package contains cleaned crash, boundary population data, four functions filter summarise crashes, Shiny app explore question interactively.

title: roadcrashVIC
text: package requires R 4.1.0 later installed GitHub:

title: roadcrashVIC
text: vic_crashes one row road crash Victoria least one person injured killed, 2012 2025, recorded Victoria Police: Two datasets support rates maps: vic_population, resident population local government area (LGA) year, vic_lga, LGA boundaries. three come Victorian Government Australian Bureau Statistics sources CC 4.0 licence. help pages (?vic_crashes, ?vic_population, ?vic_lga) describe every column changes made original files.
code: vic_crashes |>   dplyr::select(accident_date, lga_name, severity) |>   head(5) #> # A tibble: 5 × 3 #>   accident_date lga_name   severity                #>   <date>        <chr>      <fct>                   #> 1 2014-11-27    WELLINGTON Other injury accident   #> 2 2019-12-27    BANYULE    Other injury accident   #> 3 2019-10-02    BRIMBANK   Other injury accident   #> 4 2025-11-07    KNOX       Serious injury accident #> 5 2021-01-30    CARDINIA   Serious injury accident

title: roadcrashVIC
text: filter_crashes() keeps crashes two dates, included:
code: crashes_2025 <- filter_crashes(vic_crashes, start_date = "2025-01-01", end_date = "2025-12-31") range(crashes_2025$accident_date) #> [1] "2025-01-01" "2025-12-31" nrow(crashes_2025) #> [1] 15468

title: roadcrashVIC
text: summarise_crashes() counts crashes people killed injured group, casualties per 1,000 crashes. KSI stands people killed seriously injured. group can column vic_crashes, several columns together, example = c("day_of_week", "hour").
code: summarise_crashes(crashes_2025, by = "day_of_week") #> # A tibble: 7 × 10 #>   day_of_week crashes fatalities serious_injuries other_injuries   ksi #>   <fct>         <int>      <dbl>            <dbl>          <dbl> <dbl> #> 1 Monday         2065         41              804           1735   845 #> 2 Tuesday        2307         31              852           1994   883 #> 3 Wednesday      2340         41              905           2007   946 #> 4 Thursday       2290         46              810           1949   856 #> 5 Friday         2386         45              921           2016   966 #> 6 Saturday       2158         32              960           1907   992 #> 7 Sunday         1922         53              857           1687   910 #> # ℹ 4 more variables: fatalities_per_1000_crashes <dbl>, #> #   serious_injuries_per_1000_crashes <dbl>, #> #   other_injuries_per_1000_crashes <dbl>, ksi_per_1000_crashes <dbl>

text: Areas residents usually crashes. crash_rates() adds population yearly rates per 100,000 residents, make years LGAs different sizes comparable: = "lga_name", rate LGA averaged years data.

title: roadcrashVIC
text: summarise_vulnerable() applies summarise_crashes() crashes crashes involving pedestrian, cyclist motorcyclist: Note: crash involving one road users appears one row.
code: summarise_vulnerable(vic_crashes) |>   dplyr::select(road_user, crashes, ksi_per_1000_crashes) #> # A tibble: 4 × 3 #>   road_user    crashes ksi_per_1000_crashes #>   <chr>          <int>                <dbl> #> 1 All crashes   202065                 433. #> 2 Pedestrian     17696                 498. #> 3 Cyclist        19593                 337. #> 4 Motorcyclist   28362                 507.

title: roadcrashVIC
text: app uses functions data. opens browser RStudio/Positron viewer:

title: roadcrashVIC
text: Choose period analyse: first last year included. Choose metric analyse: crashes, people killed seriously injured (KSI), deaths. Show results : count, yearly rate per 100k residents, rate per 1,000 crashes. Compare population growth: option trend chart, sets first year 100 metric population. crashes happen ?: menu chart show months, days week hours day.

title: roadcrashVIC
text: Choose one LGAs analyse: 15 LGAs; Clear LGAs removes . Choose period analyse: range months; clicking month twice selects month . Choose metric analyse Show results : Victoria tab, without rates per resident, population figures published yearly. Show crashes involving: crashes, involving pedestrians, cyclists motorcyclists.

title: roadcrashVIC
text: combinations inputs give meaningful result. app shows message place affected outputs: Crashes per 1,000 crashes: always equal 1,000; app asks choose KSI deaths. LGA selected area tab: app asks choose least one. selection crashes, small area short period: outputs state crashes match selection. road user filter chart area tab: chart compares road users , asks select road users.

title: roadcrashVIC
text: Value boxes: totals selected period, average rates; title box shows scale. changed?: point one year. Compare population growth, lines start 100: values 100 higher first year, comparing two lines shows whether metric changed faster slower population. crashes happen ?: taller bars mark times higher values. Per 1,000 crashes, bars measure severe crashes instead frequent. vulnerable road user?: value crashes shown chart; comparing bar shows whether crashes involving road user average. Maps: Victoria map, darker areas higher values; area map, point one crash, coloured severity. Hovering point shows brief summary crash, clicking shows details. Roads crashes: list roads crashes selected area; ranking dangerous roads.

title: roadcrashVIC
text: Rates per resident account much people drive traffic passing area; lower rate necessarily mean safer roads. Traffic volumes included data, roads compared fairly number crashes. Small areas short periods crashes, figures can vary considerably chance. Crash numbers 2020 2021 affected COVID-19 restrictions. crashes late 2025 recorded location yet; count state-wide totals. tab app lists definitions data sources.
